notes.title: Player request update!
notes.content:
We've had a request from a Codebreaker asking for a way to switch between fullscreen/restored in-game. While it was possible to switch screen mode with the standard Windows shortcut keys (Alt + Enter), there's nothing wrong with making life easier for the players - as long as it's not about simplifying the actual challenges of course.

So, we just released an update to the game that adds buttons to switch between fullscreen/windowed mode.

Thanks for the feedback [i]Ranamo boy[/i]!
